brief.title: Automotive Systems Engineering
brief.audience: M.Tech. Automotive Engineering/Electronics students, Work Integrated Learning Programmes Division (working engineers)
textbooks: T1: Systems Engineering Handbook, A guide for system life cycle processes and activities, John Wiley & Sons, Inc., Hoboken, New Jersey, 4th Edition, 2015.
R1: Systems Engineering and Analysis, by Benjamin S Blanchard, Wolter J Fabrycky, Pearson, 5th Edition, 2013
R2: Automotive Systems Engineering, Markus Maurer, Hermann Winner (eds.), Springer-Verlag Berlin Heidelberg, 2013
brief.notes: This course introduces hard and soft skills required of good automotive systems engineers. It imparts knowledge about foundations of systems engineering to gain an in-depth knowledge of system engineering principles, processes, and methods. The course helps engineers learn and apply systems engineering (SE) methodologies in modern complex automotive system development environments. Handout course no: AE ZG517 / AEL ZG517; credit model 32-0-0; version 6.2 (12-Jan-2025); instructor SAJEETH KUMAR. T-ids are textbooks, R-ids reference books.

modules.title: Foundations of Systems Engineering
topics: Importance of systems engineering in avoiding failures
Real-world examples: Apollo 13, Therac-25, Toyota recalls
What is a system? System characteristics
When to use traditional vs MBSE
Types of requirements: functional, non-functional, constraints
modules.note: Introduction to systems engineering fundamentals, MBSE, and requirements engineering

modules.title: System Design and Analysis
topics: Analysis of real-world systems engineering failure or success
Integration strategies: big bang vs incremental
Testing types: unit, integration, system, acceptance
Verification methods: test, analysis, inspection, demonstration
modules.note: System design, operational/functional analysis, integration, verification and validation

modules.title: Technical and Project Management
topics: Scrum and Kanban in systems engineering
Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA)
modules.note: Project management, risk management, decision making, quality, agreements, and specialty engineering

modules.title: Life Cycle and Emerging Trends
topics: Safety, security, and specialty engineering aspects
Application of SE principles to complex automotive system
modules.note: Life cycle cost analysis, technical management, enabling processes, and emerging trends

objectives.text: Introduce hard and soft skills that are required of good automotive systems engineers
Impart the knowledge about foundations of systems engineering to gain an in-depth knowledge of system engineering principles, processes, and methods
Help engineers to learn and apply the systems engineering (SE) methodologies in modern complex automotive system development environments

outcomes.text: Describe processes, methods, and practices of systems engineering
Develop requirements, architectures, specifications, verifications, and tests
Recognize important systems engineering and systems thinking strategies and practices
Apply systems engineering practices and methods in automotive systems
Analyse automotive systems using systems engineering approaches to increase performance
